<p class="page-deck">The lab studies climate action as a problem of learning and delivery: how evidence is made, moved, interpreted and put to work in particular places.</p>

::: {.notice}
**Connected scope.** Themes overlap. Projects and publications have one primary theme and may be cross-listed under related themes; geography, method, domain and sector remain separate.
:::

{{< include generated/research-themes.qmd >}}

## A connected programme

The themes are not silos. Evidence infrastructure shapes what can be known; governance determines what can be delivered; valuation affects which outcomes count; and workforce change determines who can participate and benefit. Canadian climate-policy research provides the institutional and place-based context connecting them.
